_note: Four FICTIONAL demo businesses. Their names, websites, sender IDs and customer records are invented for the Kavach demo and do not belong to any real company. A real member business replaces its entry with its own channels, rules and actions, and serves real records through the business-records table.

businesses.name: Kalpavi Bank
businesses.how_you_pay: Kalpavi Bank never collects money through UPI IDs, QR codes or links sent in messages; payments happen only in the Kalpavi app or at a branch
never: asks for an OTP, UPI PIN, CVV or password
sends links to update KYC or PAN (KYC is updated only in the Kalpavi app or at a branch)
blocks an account over WhatsApp or SMS without a branch notice
asks you to install screen-sharing or other apps
calls from personal mobile numbers (it calls only from 1600-series numbers)

businesses.name: Nidhira Health Insurance
businesses.how_you_pay: Nidhira collects premiums only in the Nidhira app, at nidhirahealth.in or by an auto-debit you set up, never through UPI IDs or links sent in messages
never: asks for an OTP, PIN or password
